Amit Dubey counsel with Shri Priyank Khandewal for the
applicant.
Shri Y.N. Gupta, counsel for the respondent/State.
Heard on I.A. 18631 of 2015 for taking documents on record.
For want of objection, the application is allowed and documents are taken on record.
Heard on I.A. No. 26291 of 2013 for grant of stay.

The institution of the proceedings have been challenged mainly on the grounds that the proceedings are barred by limitation in view of Section 77 of the Public Standards and Food Safety Act and inspite of a nomination having been made under rule 2.5.1, the Directors have been impleaded as parties.

sentences.text: However, it may be noted that the charge-sheet in the case has been filed on 26.4.2013 i.e. about 2  years ago; as such, before proceedings further, it would be appropriate to ascertain the status of the trial.
Therefore, it is directed that the applicants shall file certified copies of last few order sheets of the trial Court in order to demonstrate the status of the trial.

Meanwhile, by way of interim measure, it is directed that if the trial is not already concluded, the trial Court may proceed with the trial but shall not pass judgment therein till the next date of hearing.

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
The institution of the proceedings have been challenged mainly on the grounds that the proceedings are barred by limitation in view of Section 77 of the Public Standards and Food Safety Act and inspite of a nomination having been made under rule 2.5.1, the Directors have been impleaded as parties.
However, it may be noted that the charge-sheet in the case has been filed on 26.4.2013 i.e. about 2  years ago; as such, before proceedings further, it would be appropriate to ascertain the status of the trial.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Therefore, it is directed that the applicants shall file certified copies of last few order sheets of the trial Court in order to demonstrate the status of the trial.
Meanwhile, by way of interim measure, it is directed that if the trial is not already concluded, the trial Court may proceed with the trial but shall not pass judgment therein till the next date of hearing.
